content.rationale: The verb reads the node set through store_list (which reads through store_read over the runner), resolves targets through store_resolve, parses ids through store_path, builds failures through refusal, and takes its context; it also reads every change with the paths it touched through the one-crossing custody read jj_custody::read, derives each change's owning set through node_own::owned rather than attributing ownership a second time, and applies xotxspwp's rule as given, comparing each change's paths with the set it owns; building the gate's own crate typechecks all of those calls, and the comparison between them, at once, so the fan-out is gated without a second owner for the crate.
